This page says how to render an implementation guide **through the harness**
from a terminal, on your own machine or in an agent's container. The output
is the same just-the-docs site the publish workflow deploys.

A harnessed render has two halves:

1. **Build the IG's AST once.** This is the only step that runs the IG
   Publisher. It writes `output-ast/`, one JSON dump per resource.
2. **Render the site from that AST.** The harness never reads the
   Publisher's `output/` HTML. The AST is the one input to the site build.

The steps below are listed in that order. To deploy the result, see
[Publishing an IG](publishing.html).

## Harnessed or bare: two routes
{: #two-routes data-fa-label="sec:run-locally-two-routes" }

[✎ Edit](https://github.com/litlfred/fhir-harness/edit/main/docs/source/fhir-run-locally/two-routes.md){: .fa-node-edit title="Edit docs/source/fhir-run-locally/two-routes.md" data-fa-link="edit" data-src="docs/source/fhir-run-locally/two-routes.md" data-repo="litlfred/fhir-harness" } <span class="fa-qa-badges"><button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-block" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="block" data-qa-key="two-routes.block" data-qa-label="Content QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/two-routes.block.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Content QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Content QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">QA</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button> <button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-translation" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="translation" data-qa-key="two-routes.translation" data-qa-label="Translation QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/two-routes.translation.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Translation QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Translation QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">TR</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button></span>

| | **Harnessed** (this layer) | **Bare** (the IG Publisher alone) |
|---|---|---|
| When it is taken | the IG repository has an `index.config.json` naming its landing layer, `"site": { "landing": "<layer>" }` | the repository has no `index.config.json`, or you pass `--bare-ig` |
| What runs the Publisher | `AstExportCli`, an entry point added to a fork of the Publisher ([litlfred/fhir-ig-publisher](https://github.com/litlfred/fhir-ig-publisher)), pinned by commit | the repository's own `ghbuild.yml` steps (stock `publisher.jar`, latest release) |
| What the site is built from | the AST (`output-ast/`, or the cache branch) | the Publisher's `output/` as it lays it out |
| What you get | thin just-the-docs pages, a JSON-LD node per artefact, the artefact index, search, a language picker | the Publisher's HTML |
| Version pinned? | yes: SUSHI, Java and Node in `scripts/ig-toolchain.env`; the Publisher by the `ast-export` commit | no: the version floats (see [the IG Publisher](ig-publisher.html#the-version-floats)) |

Both routes start with one command, `stage-local.ts`. It takes the harnessed
route whenever it can. Do not pass `--bare-ig` to a harnessed IG unless you
want the Publisher's own pages.

## What you need installed
{: #prerequisites data-fa-label="sec:run-locally-prerequisites" }

[✎ Edit](https://github.com/litlfred/fhir-harness/edit/main/docs/source/fhir-run-locally/prerequisites.md){: .fa-node-edit title="Edit docs/source/fhir-run-locally/prerequisites.md" data-fa-link="edit" data-src="docs/source/fhir-run-locally/prerequisites.md" data-repo="litlfred/fhir-harness" } <span class="fa-qa-badges"><button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-block" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="block" data-qa-key="prerequisites.block" data-qa-label="Content QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/prerequisites.block.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Content QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Content QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">QA</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button> <button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-translation" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="translation" data-qa-key="prerequisites.translation" data-qa-label="Translation QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/prerequisites.translation.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Translation QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Translation QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">TR</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button></span>

| Tool | Needed for | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `bun` | every step | the harness's runtime; use the version in `cat-harness/.bun-version` |
| `git`, `bash`, `curl` | every step | |
| Java 17, `mvn` | building the AST | Maven compiles `AstExportCli` from the Publisher fork |
| Node 20, `npm` | building the AST | for SUSHI `3.21.0`, which the build script installs if missing |
| Ruby, `gem` | building the AST and rendering | Jekyll, which the build script installs if missing |
| `python3` with `venv` | rendering | checked by `stage-local.ts` before it starts |
| Docker | bare route only | when the IG's own workflow runs the Publisher in a container image |

Building the AST also needs network access to `packages.fhir.org`, the
terminology server (default `http://tx.fhir.org`) and Maven Central. If
`packages.fhir.org` is refused, see the `fhir-validation` skill, §"When a
package host refuses you".

The layers come from the IG's `index.lock.json`. From the IG repository's
root, mount them the way the publish workflow does:

```bash
ref=$(python3 -c "import json;print(next(m['ref'] for m in json.load(open('index.lock.json'))['mounts'] if m['harness']=='cat-harness-tools'))")
M=$(mktemp -d) && git -C "$M" init -q
git -C "$M" fetch -q --depth 1 https://github.com/litlfred/cat-harness-tools.git "$ref"
git -C "$M" checkout -q FETCH_HEAD
bun run "$M/scripts/mount-from-lock.ts" --root .
```

## The one command
{: #the-one-command data-fa-label="sec:run-locally-the-one-command" }

[✎ Edit](https://github.com/litlfred/fhir-harness/edit/main/docs/source/fhir-run-locally/the-one-command.md){: .fa-node-edit title="Edit docs/source/fhir-run-locally/the-one-command.md" data-fa-link="edit" data-src="docs/source/fhir-run-locally/the-one-command.md" data-repo="litlfred/fhir-harness" } <span class="fa-qa-badges"><button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-block" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="block" data-qa-key="the-one-command.block" data-qa-label="Content QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/the-one-command.block.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Content QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Content QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">QA</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button> <button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-translation" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="translation" data-qa-key="the-one-command.translation" data-qa-label="Translation QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/the-one-command.translation.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Translation QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Translation QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">TR</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button></span>

From the IG repository's root, with the layers mounted:

```bash
# 1. Build the AST (one Publisher run; minutes to tens of minutes)
bun run cat prepare:fhir-harness

# 2. See what would be built and where, and stop
bun run cat stage:local --repo . --plan

# 3. Build the site and compose the publish commit, pushing nothing
bun run cat stage:local --repo . --dry-run
```

`bun run cat <name>` runs a script that any mounted layer declares.
`prepare:fhir-harness` is `bash fhir-harness/scripts/ig-ast-build.sh --ig-root .`,
and `stage:local` is `cat-harness-tools/scripts/stage-local.ts`.

Other ways to finish:

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `bun run cat stage:local --repo . --artifact <dir>` | writes a bundle you can open as a page, instead of pushing |
| `bun run cat stage:local --repo .` | publishes. On the default branch it publishes the site root; on any other branch, a preview at `branches/<branch>/` |

You can skip step 1 when the IG's cache branch already holds an AST that is
valid for your commit: the render restores it.

## Step by step
{: #step-by-step data-fa-label="sec:run-locally-step-by-step" }

[✎ Edit](https://github.com/litlfred/fhir-harness/edit/main/docs/source/fhir-run-locally/step-by-step.md){: .fa-node-edit title="Edit docs/source/fhir-run-locally/step-by-step.md" data-fa-link="edit" data-src="docs/source/fhir-run-locally/step-by-step.md" data-repo="litlfred/fhir-harness" } <span class="fa-qa-badges"><button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-block" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="block" data-qa-key="step-by-step.block" data-qa-label="Content QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/step-by-step.block.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Content QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Content QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">QA</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button> <button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-translation" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="translation" data-qa-key="step-by-step.translation" data-qa-label="Translation QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/step-by-step.translation.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Translation QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Translation QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">TR</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button></span>

`stage-local.ts` runs these named steps in order. The layers supply them, so
you can also run any one of them on its own with `bun run cat <step>`:

| # | Step | Script | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `ig-site:ast` | `ig-repo-site.ts ast` | restores the AST from the cache branch `cat/fhir-harness/fhir-ast/<package id>` (or keeps a valid `output-ast/`), and refuses a stale one |
| 2 | `ig-site:sidecars` | the landing layer's own | *optional*: API sidecars from the AST, when the landing layer has this step |
| 3 | `ig-index:build` | `build-ig-indexes.ts` | the artefact index, menu and releases in `fhir-artifact-index/` |
| 4 | `ig-site:compose` | `ig-repo-site.ts compose` | the thin artefact pages, with the IG's own pages composed at the site root |
| 5 | `ig-site:openapi` | cat-harness-tools | *optional*: a page per OpenAPI operation, when the IG has `openapi/cat-openapi.config.json` |
| 6 | `ig-site:publisher-pages` | `ig-repo-site.ts publisher-pages` | serves the AST's data, guards against leftover Publisher chrome, stamps the build |
| 7 | `ig-site:bar` | `ig-repo-site.ts bar` | the language picker and the IG's slim bar |

The scripts' own usage lines:

```text
ig-repo-site.ts ast [--ig <checkout>] [--work <dir>]
ig-repo-site.ts compose <site source> [--ig <checkout>] [--baseurl <base>] [--plantuml-jar <jar>] [--work <dir>]
ig-repo-site.ts publisher-pages <built site> [--ig <checkout>] [--work <dir>]
ig-repo-site.ts bar <built site> [--ig <checkout>]

ig-ast-build.sh [--ig-root DIR] [--tx URL] [--ast-export-ref SHA] [--work DIR] [--template-repo ID=OWNER/REPO]…
```

To publish an AST you built yourself to the cache branch, so the next render
and CI can reuse it (only from a default-branch commit):

```bash
bash fhir-harness/scripts/ig-cache.sh seed --ig-root . --push
```

{: #settings data-fa-label="sec:run-locally-settings" }

[✎ Edit](https://github.com/litlfred/fhir-harness/edit/main/docs/source/fhir-run-locally/settings.md){: .fa-node-edit title="Edit docs/source/fhir-run-locally/settings.md" data-fa-link="edit" data-src="docs/source/fhir-run-locally/settings.md" data-repo="litlfred/fhir-harness" } <span class="fa-qa-badges"><button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-block" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="block" data-qa-key="settings.block" data-qa-label="Content QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/settings.block.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Content QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Content QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">QA</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button> <button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-translation" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="translation" data-qa-key="settings.translation" data-qa-label="Translation QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/settings.translation.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Translation QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Translation QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">TR</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button></span>

| Variable | Read by | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `SITE_WORK` | `ig-repo-site.ts` | working directory; the default for `--work` |
| `FOLIO_SITE_BASEURL` | `ig-repo-site.ts compose` | the site's base URL when `--baseurl` is not given |
| `SITE_ACCEPT_STALE_AST=1` | `ig-repo-site.ts ast` | accept a stale AST. Use it **for a preview only**; never for the site root |
| `IG_TEMPLATE_REPOS` | `ig-ast-build.sh` | extra `--template-repo ID=OWNER/REPO` values, for an IG template that is not on the CI build server |
| `TMPDIR` | `ig-ast-build.sh` | where the work directory goes (default `$TMPDIR/ig-ast-build`) |

`stage-local.ts` sets the others itself (`SITE_INSTANCE`, `SITE_BASEURL`,
`SITE_URL`, `SITE_SOURCE`, `SITE_DIR` and the rest) when it calls each step.

## When it refuses
{: #when-it-refuses data-fa-label="sec:run-locally-when-it-refuses" }

[✎ Edit](https://github.com/litlfred/fhir-harness/edit/main/docs/source/fhir-run-locally/when-it-refuses.md){: .fa-node-edit title="Edit docs/source/fhir-run-locally/when-it-refuses.md" data-fa-link="edit" data-src="docs/source/fhir-run-locally/when-it-refuses.md" data-repo="litlfred/fhir-harness" } <span class="fa-qa-badges"><button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-block" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="block" data-qa-key="when-it-refuses.block" data-qa-label="Content QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/when-it-refuses.block.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Content QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Content QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">QA</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button> <button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-translation" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="translation" data-qa-key="when-it-refuses.translation" data-qa-label="Translation QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/when-it-refuses.translation.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-run-locally/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Translation QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Translation QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">TR</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button></span>

| Message or symptom | Cause | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| the AST is stale, cannot-tell, or missing | no AST matches your commit's inputs | run `bun run cat prepare:fhir-harness`, or the `ig-ast-refresh` workflow |
| `index.config.json` has no `site.landing` | the IG is harnessed but does not say which layer's chrome it wears | add `"site": { "landing": "<layer>" }` |
| a prerequisite is missing | `docker`, `python3 -m venv`, `bash` or `curl` was not found | install it; the plan names which one |
| `ig-ast-build: the AST just built is not valid` | the inputs changed during the build | commit or stash, then build again |
| the Publisher cannot fetch a package | `packages.fhir.org` is unreachable | see the `fhir-validation` skill, §"When a package host refuses you" |

Exit codes of `ig-ast-site.sh`: `1` means no AST could be restored; `3`
means the AST was restored but could not be turned into pages.
